description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization logic for callstack debug info in PyTorch JIT, including handling inlined call stacks, module instance info, and pickling/unpickling functions.

classes.name: InlinedCallStackSerializer
classes.description: Serializes inlined call stack objects into IValues, including module info, source range tags, callee info, and function names.

classes.name: InlinedCallStackDeserializer
classes.description: Deserializes IValues back into inlined call stack objects, reconstructing source ranges, callees, and module info.

classes.name: CallStackDebugInfoPickler
classes.description: Handles pickling of debug info maps into byte vectors.

classes.name: CallStackDebugInfoUnpickler
classes.description: Handles unpickling of debug info byte vectors back into structured debug info maps.
